facts.value: Students must maintain continuous enrollment which is defined as enrollment in both fall and spring semesters with summer sessions not included.
Students must earn a minimum of 24 credits during the yearly fall/spring review period.

Students may not use credits from summer sessions and consortium agreement classes, repeated classes, incomplete grades or audited classes, or any credits received by examination, including AP, CLEP, IB and other tests for meeting the minimum 24 credit hours requirement, although these credits may still count toward their overall credits for degree completion.
Students must maintain a 2.00 minimum ASU cumulative GPA.
